project_purpose: A personal developer and DevOps blog by Nikila Fernando, built on Quartz v4 (static site generator). Publishes technical long-form articles, TIL notes, tool writeups, and project case studies in the domains of DevOps, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure. Deployed at nikila.dev.

architecture_notes.stack: Quartz v4.5.2 (TypeScript SSG built on Preact, Unified/Remark/Rehype, esbuild, FlexSearch)

environments.name: local-dev
environments.notes: Started via `npx quartz build --serve` in blog_dot_me/ directory

environments.name: production
environments.notes: Production — do NOT run automated QA traffic against this

auth_method.notes: Public static site, no authentication required

features.description: The root index page (content/index.md) renders a terminal-aesthetic hero with a whoami block, a blog section table, and a recent posts list. Acts as the primary entry point for all visitors.

[INFERRED] Page title contains '~/nikila.dev'

coverage_gaps.description: SPEC.md is missing entirely. All acceptance criteria in this Content Engine are agent-inferred from quartz.config.ts, quartz.layout.ts, and content files. No formal specification was available to validate against.
WALKTHROUGH.md is missing entirely. All user_flow_steps are agent-inferred from page content and Quartz upstream documentation. No narrated walkthrough was available.

README.md present but is the upstream Quartz template README (jackyzha0/quartz), not a project-specific README for nikila.dev. Project purpose was inferred from quartz.config.ts and content/index.md instead.
Content sections til/, tools/, notes/ have very few posts (1-2 each). The projects/ section only has an index.md with no posts. Category page QA will have limited content to verify against.

Graph view feature (F-08) is available in standard Quartz but not explicitly configured in quartz.layout.ts. It may or may not appear depending on default Quartz component behavior. Verification needed at runtime.
No test accounts or credential placeholders defined — not applicable for this project as it is a public read-only static site with no authentication.
